CC/SA/HA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA - JUNE 16, 2020 - 6PM & 7PM
CC/SA/HA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA - JUNE 16, 2020 - 6PM & 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, JUNE 16, 2020
6:00 P.M.
CLOSED SESSION 6:00 P.M./ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 7:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. CC/SA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA & HA 1486
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
IMPORTANT PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY MESSAGE REGARDING PARTICIPATION AT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
As a result of the COVID-19 emergency, and resulting orders and direction from the President of the United States, the Governor of the State of California, and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health, as well as the City of Palmdale emergency declaration, the public will not be permitted to physically attend the City Council meeting. Councilmembers may choose to participate via conference call.
How to Observe the Meeting:
1) Spectrum local access Channel 27
2) Online live webcast at cityofpalmdale.org.
How to Submit Public Comments through Palmdale eComments on this Agenda:
Note: Public Comments submitted will become part of the official meeting record.
1)Go to the Agendas & Minutes webpage at https://cityofpalmdale.org/310/City-Council-Meetings and find this meeting under Upcoming Events; 2) Click on the eComment button; and 3) Scroll through the agenda to find the agenda item for which you would like to provide a comment and submit your comment.
Please note: The City Council is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
1. CALL TO ORDER 6:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS 4.1 THROUGH 4.3.
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
City of Palmdale v. Rodney Bruce, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. MC 027 808
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of these matters and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public
4.2 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
CA Smoke & Vape Association, Inc., et al. v. City of Palmdale
United States District Court – Central District of California Case No. 2:20-cv-5039
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of these matters and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.3 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of:
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
Title: Interim City Attorney
The City Council will discuss, and possibly appoint, an Interim City Attorney.
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54957(b).
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
7. ADJOURN CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
8. CALL TO ORDER 7:00 P.M. CC/SA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA MEETINGS.
9. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
10. ROLL CALL: MAYOR / CHAIR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM / VICE CHAIR /CHAIR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS / DIRECTORS / MEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
11. PRESENTATION:
11.1 Proclamation by Mayor and Council presented to the OUTreach Center proclaiming June 2020 as LGBTQ Pride Month in the City of Palmdale.
12. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
13. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM NOS. 14.1 THROUGH 14.5 AND NON-AGENDA ITEMS.
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar.
14. CONSENT CALENDAR:
14.1 Approve the Side Letter of Agreement with Teamsters Local 911 to amend Section 2.01 Wages and Section 3.01 Health Insurance Programs, Agreement No. A-5873. (Staff Reference: Human Resources Manager Nevarez)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the Side Letter of Agreement with Teamsters Local 911 to amend Section 2.01 Wages and Section 3.01 Health Insurance Programs, Agreement No. A-5873
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 14.1
14.2 Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-077, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale authorizing application for, and receipt of, Local Early Action Planning Grant Program (LEAP) funds. (Staff Reference: Acting Director of Economic and Community Development Behen)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-077
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 14.2
14.3 Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-078, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale, California, calling for the holding of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, for the election of certain officers as required by the provisions of the City of Palmdale Charter. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-078
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 14.3
14.4 Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-079, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale, California, adopting regulations for candidates for elective office pertaining to candidates’ statements submitted to the voters at the General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-079
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 14.4
14.5 Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-080, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to order the consolidation of a General Municipal Election to be held on November 3, 2020 with the Statewide General Election to be held in the County of Los Angeles the same day; to authorize the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to canvass the returns of said General Municipal Election; and to request that the Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk of said county be permitted to render full services to the City of Palmdale relating to the conduct of said General Municipal Election pursuant to California Elections Code Section 10403. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-080
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 14.5
15. ALL AGENCIES (CC/SA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA) REMAIN OPEN, CALL HOUSING AUTHORITY MEETING TO ORDER AND TAKE ROLL CALL AT THIS TIME.
16. CALL TO ORDER THE HOUSING AUTHORITY MEETING.
17. ROLL CALL: CHAIR HOFBAUER, VICE CHAIR LOA, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, BISHOP, BROWN, AND FRAGA-SAENZ
18. (CONTINUED FROM THE JUNE 2, 2020 MEETING) JOINT PUBLIC HEARING OF THE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY, AND HOUSING AUTHORITY:
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Joint Resolution No. CC 2020-070, SA 2020-008, PCA 2020-001, IDA 2020-001, PAA 2020-001, AND PFA 2020-001 approving and adopting the City of Palmdale's budget for fiscal year 2020-21 and approving revenue and expenditure adjustments to fiscal year 2019-20.
Adopt Joint Resolution No. HA 2020-003.
18.1 JOINT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2020-070, SA 2020-008, PCA 2020-001, HA 2020-003, IDA 2020-001, PAA 2020-001, AND PFA 2020-001, A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND THE PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE CITY OF PALMDALE'S BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 AND APPROVING REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE ADJUSTMENTS TO FISCAL YEAR 2019-20. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Kang)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Joint Resolution No. CC 2020-070, SA 2020-008, PCA 2020-001, IDA 2020-001, PAA 2020-001, AND PFA 2020-001 approving and adopting the City of Palmdale's budget for fiscal year 2020-21 and approving revenue and expenditure adjustments to fiscal year 2019-20.
Adopt Joint Resolution No. HA 2020-003.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 18.1
PowerPoint Presentations
19. ADJOURN HOUSING AUTHORITY MEETING.
20. RETURN TO CITY COUNCIL MEETING.
21. PUBLIC HEARING:
21.1 (THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO THE JULY 14, 2020 CC MEETING) APPEAL 20-002: AN APPEAL OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION'S INTERPRETATION REGARDING ALLOWABLE USES WITHIN THE ANTELOPE VALLEY BUSINESS PARK SPECIFIC PLAN FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN AUTOMOTIVE AUCTION USE LOCATED SOUTH OF AVENUE M AN WEST OF 10TH STREET WEST. (Staff Reference: Acting Director of Economic and Community Development Behen)
Staff Recommendation: Continue this item to July 14, 2020.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 21.1
22. NEW BUSINESS:
22.1 Approve First Amendment to the Employment Agreement with John J. Murphy, City Manager, Agreement No. A-6843. (Staff Reference: Human Resources Manager Nevarez)
Staff Recommendation: Approve First Amendment to Agreement No. A-6843.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 22.1
22.2 Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-073, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale authorizing and approving temporary Palmdale Municipal Code and/or operational conditions of approval modifications to provide temporary outdoor dining (Palmdale's "Al Fresco" Dining Program. (Staff Reference: Acting Director of Economic and Community Development Behen)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2020-073.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 22.2
PowerPoint Presentation
23. ADJOURNMENT.
